changeSet.author: tchoi
changeSet.comment: Remove duplicate group memberships created by concurrent adds (RSDEV-1400). Keeps the lowest-id UserGroup row for each group and user unchanged (the row the application loads and edits) and deletes the others, then deletes duplicate live links to group shared folders, group shared-snippet folders and members' home folders, keeping the lowest id. Every deleted row is copied first to RSDEV1400_RemovedUserGroup or RSDEV1400_RemovedRecordToFolder with the id of the row kept; these backup tables are kept on purpose for a manual restore. Each statement can be rerun.

changeSet.author: tchoi

preConditions.onFailMessage: UserGroup has an index named uk_UserGroup_group_user that is not a unique key on exactly (group_id, user_id); drop or rename it, then restart.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = 'UserGroup' AND INDEX_NAME = 'uk_UserGroup_group_user' HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 AND NOT ( COUNT(*) = 2 AND SUM(NON_UNIQUE) = 0 AND SUM(SUB_PART IS NOT NULL) = 0 AND SUM(SEQ_IN_INDEX = 1 AND COLUMN_NAME = 'group_id') = 1 AND SUM(SEQ_IN_INDEX = 2 AND COLUMN_NAME = 'user_id') = 1)) incompatible
